text:
devops-bot: ALERT: notify-ingress webhook 10.4.3.21 failing to ACK upstream requests (x-retry=3) - 502/timeout spike

sre-lead: seeing a flood of failed webhooks in the gateway logs, ack window 30s is timing out

alex: confirmed, gateway -> external-pager returns 504 on retry 2, payload size ~18KB

maria: omg that's the new header rewrite landed last night? could be stripping x-ttl header

oncall-1: missed pages — I didn't get a notification. did pagerbot send anything?

pagerbot: outgoing page sent to +1-555-0102, status=queued, provider-ack=missing

sre-lead: looks like the pagerbridge is receiving pages but not mapping TTL -> provider timeout, so they drop before escalation

alex: quick mitigation: re-enable legacy header passthrough on notify-ingress (flip feature flag)

maria: rolling flag now in prod: /api/flags/notify-ingress/legacy-headers -> true

oncall-1: manual page attempt: `curl -X POST https://notify.internal/push -d '{"msg":"test"}'` -> got 200 from ingress, provider ack still missing

sre-lead: good, the flag reverted header rewrite. I'm seeing provider ack come back for new messages

pagerbot: provider-ack restored for new pages, escalation pipeline resumed :white_check_mark:

customer-success: FYI some customers reported delayed SMS pages for 14 minutes; CS opened ticket INC-8423 and started manual outreach

alex: root cause hypothesis: header rewrite removed x-ttl, gateway treated TTL=0 and dropped escalation to external provider; regression from recent deploy to notify-ingress v2.3.1

maria: collecting logs for all requests between 1845670000 - 1845671200 and saving to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1845671234/

oncall-1: live mitigation notes: re-enabled legacy headers, manually retried 27 queued events via admin UI, paged affected oncall lists directly

sre-lead: customer impact: delayed pages for ~230 customers, no complete misses confirmed, but degraded SLA for 14 minutes window. CS will follow up with affected customers

alex: next steps: create PR to add integration test for TTL header passthrough, add a canary check that triggers a synthetic page every deploy, and add alert when provider-ack rate < 95% for 5m

maria: PR draft #4287 -> will include unit and e2e tests, and a rollback playbook in ops-runbook repo

sre-lead: thanks all — filing postmortem, tagging for follow-up ops tasks and build the canary. assigning to alex/maria for fixes, oncall-1 for runbook updates

oncall-1: ack, will update runbook and send summary to #incidents-retrospectives

devops-bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, impact=degraded-paging, duration=00:14:06, mitigated_by=feature-flag-revert

alex: adding note — check provider SDK change that started enforcing TTL semantics last month, might need coordinated compatibility testing

customer-success: I'll post the customer notif once PM approves wording, and attach a short SLA impact note

sre-lead: closing thread here, we'll queue postmortem in retro board and link to logs + PRs
